leads.title: Bostic v. Rainey / Bostic v. Schaefer
leads.documents: Federal decisions striking down Virginia's same-sex marriage ban; same-sex marriage legal in Virginia since October 6, 2014 after U.S. Supreme Court refused appeal
leads.detail: Cited as Feb 13, 2014 district decision, July 28, 2014 Fourth Circuit 2-1 ruling, Supreme Court stay Aug 20, 2014, mandate Oct 6, 2014 at 1 p.m.; first couple Lindsey Oliver and Nicole Pries in Richmond

leads.title: Virginia Values Act
leads.documents: Statewide law prohibiting discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity in employment, housing, public accommodations, and credit
leads.detail: Passed Virginia General Assembly Feb 6, 2020, signed April 11, 2020 by Gov. Ralph Northam, effective July 1, 2020; described as first of its kind in Southern United States

leads.title: Virginia hate crime law amendment
leads.documents: Addition of sexual orientation and gender identity to state's hate crime laws covering violence based on race, religious conviction, color, national origin, disability, gender, sexual orientation and gender identity
leads.detail: Signed March 4, 2020 by Gov. Ralph Northam, effective July 1, 2020

leads.title: HB 2132 - repeal of gay and trans panic defense
leads.documents: Repeal of gay panic / trans panic defense in Virginia
leads.detail: Passed Virginia General Assembly March 2021, signed by Gov. Ralph Northam, effective July 1

leads.title: Gloucester County transgender bathroom case
leads.documents: Court ruling that Gloucester County school board acted unlawfully in preventing transgender high school student from using boys' bathroom; U.S. Supreme Court in 2021 let lower court ruling stand
leads.detail: Cited as 2014 denial of boys' bathroom access, lower court for student, Supreme Court declined review in 2021

leads.title: Virginia Department of Education - 2023 policies on transgender students
leads.documents: Explicit state education policies banning bathroom access and pronoun usage for transgender individuals within all schools and classrooms
leads.detail: Passed July 2023; article notes intended reversal by governor-elect Abigail Spanberger in 2026

leads.title: Virginia High School League transgender sports ban
leads.documents: Ban on transgender athletes from girls' sports enforcement machinery for athletics
leads.detail: Enacted February 2025 following Trump's executive order

leads.title: Virginia gender marker reforms - X driver's license and birth certificate
leads.documents: State offering X gender marker on driver's licenses and allowing birth certificate sex change with 'appropriate clinical treatment' without surgery
leads.detail: Driver's license X effective July 1, 2020; birth certificate reform effective Sept 1, 2020; prior rule since 1979 required sex reassignment surgery

leads.title: French Quarter Cafe v. Virginia Alcoholic Beverage Control Board
leads.documents: 1991 federal court decision declaring ABC ban on gay bars unconstitutional
leads.detail: Strikes down 1934 Board of Virginia Alcoholic Beverage Control Authority regulations banning gay bars and bars employing and serving gays and lesbians
